C-RELEASE-REWRITE-BOUNDARY.IntentSummary: Extend the strict previous-release boundary of tools/release-readiness.mjs so a release whose following history was rewritten is proved by a recorded previousRelease.historyRewrite delta ({ date, deltaPaths }) that must exactly match the tag-to-bootstrap diff and stay outside product paths, while the bootstrapSha-equals-commit and same-tree behaviors, tag/tree identity, ancestry and commit accounting stay byte-identical; deterministic fixtures cover every acceptance criterion and one dated README note records the boundary.
C-RELEASE-REWRITE-BOUNDARY.ApprovalBasis: Approved active spec C-RELEASE-REWRITE-BOUNDARY (status="approved", SHA-256 71e135fa0df91dd43cef44156366b30e54891687e54187a97d36e9b0deff80a4) plus its non-normative design context. Plan-time resolutions of the design-context deferred decisions: the named constants are PRODUCT_PREFIXES and PRODUCT_FILES; the existing strictRepository fixture case is not migrated (spec constraint wins over the empty-delta alternative) and new fixtures extend it through an opt-in default-off parameter; the auxiliary rejection message details follow the existing `entries=missing`-style tokens (historyRewrite=missing, historyRewrite=date, historyRewrite=deltaPaths, historyRewrite=unexpected) with the spec-fixed rewrite=delta-drift and rewrite=product-drift; TRAIN_SCHEMA_VERSION stays "1.0.0" per spec Assumption 2. No tag creation/move/re-point, no history rewrite, no merge of the pre-rewrite line into main, no docs/release-trains/2.9.x-next.json edit, no release authorization, admission, version or publication action is delegated by this change.

T-001.Title: Prove the rewritten previous-release boundary in validateStrictRepositoryState

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In tools/release-readiness.mjs add the named constants PRODUCT_PREFIXES = ['src/', 'src-tauri/', 'static/', 'mark-quicklook/'] and PRODUCT_FILES = ['package.json', 'package-lock.json', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'rust-toolchain.toml'] and extend validateStrictRepositoryState so that: when previousRelease.bootstrapSha equals previousRelease.commit, or when the bootstrapSha tree equals previousRelease.tree, the strict proof stays byte-identical to today (the tag-target check, the tag-tree check and the bootstrap-tree check still fail with MT_RELEASE_PREVIOUS_BOUNDARY_INVALID 'tree=drift', ancestry still fails with 'bootstrap=not-ancestor') and a present previousRelease.historyRewrite field is rejected; otherwise (bootstrapSha differs from commit and its tree differs from previousRelease.tree) previousRelease.historyRewrite = { date, deltaPaths } is required and proved: date follows the same YYYY-MM-DD real-calendar rule as testingProtocol dates; deltaPaths is a non-empty list of unique repository-relative paths in sorted order; the list must equal `git diff --name-only <commit> <bootstrapSha>` exactly (same paths, same count, same order) or the boundary fails with MT_RELEASE_PREVIOUS_BOUNDARY_INVALID rewrite=delta-drift; and no entry may start with a PRODUCT_PREFIXES prefix or equal a PRODUCT_FILES entry or the boundary fails with MT_RELEASE_PREVIOUS_BOUNDARY_INVALID rewrite=product-drift. The recorded commit must keep matching `rev-parse <tag>^{commit}`, previousRelease.tree must keep matching the tag tree, bootstrapSha must stay an ancestor of the payload, commitAccounting.fromExclusive must stay equal to previousRelease.bootstrapSha and the exact rev-list accounting through the payload must be unchanged; TRAIN_SCHEMA_VERSION stays '1.0.0'. Update FILE/VERSION, MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP (new constants plus the rewritten boundary wording) and START_CHANGE_SUMMARY per the repository canon.

T-002.Title: Cover the seven rewrite-boundary acceptance criteria with deterministic fixtures

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In tests/renderer/release-readiness.test.js extend strictRepository with an opt-in default-off history-rewrite bootstrap (a commit after the annotated tag whose tree differs from the baseline tree through non-product paths only, mirroring the real v2.8.2-to-main situation) without changing the existing default case — the empty bootstrap commit whose tree equals the tagged baseline tree keeps passing with no historyRewrite field. Add deterministic fixtures proving: a product-free deltaPaths list exactly matching `git diff --name-only <commit> <bootstrapSha>` passes strict validation with all other evidence valid; an extra, missing or reordered deltaPaths entry fails with MT_RELEASE_PREVIOUS_BOUNDARY_INVALID rewrite=delta-drift; a deltaPaths entry starting with a product prefix or equaling a product file fails with MT_RELEASE_PREVIOUS_BOUNDARY_INVALID rewrite=product-drift; a differing bootstrap tree without a historyRewrite field, with a non-YYYY-MM-DD or non-calendar date, or with a non-list deltaPaths fails with MT_RELEASE_PREVIOUS_BOUNDARY_INVALID; the same-tree bootstrap (bootstrapSha different from commit) passes without historyRewrite and a present historyRewrite field there fails; and the legacy 'tree=drift' and 'bootstrap=not-ancestor' negative controls still fail while the checked-in Collecting train (bootstrapSha equal to commit, no historyRewrite) still validates unchanged. No timeout or assertion weakening; no GitHub API or publication behavior.

T-003.Title: Record the dated rewrite-boundary note and synchronize M-046/V-M-046

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add exactly one dated boundary note to docs/release-trains/README.md, adjacent to the 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-24 boundary notes in the automated preparation and publication boundary section, explaining that after a post-release history rewrite a train anchors previousRelease.commit/tree at the real annotated tag target, starts commit accounting at a current-history bootstrapSha, and proves the tag-to-bootstrap delta with previousRelease.historyRewrite { date, deltaPaths } confined to non-product paths — with no tag creation/move/re-point, no history rewrite, no merge of the pre-rewrite line into main and no docs/release-trains/2.9.x-next.json bookkeeping in this change. Record the change in the routed M-046 SummaryDelta (.grace/graph/features.xml) and a V-M-046 Scenario (.grace/verification/features.xml), and add the one-line change comments to .grace/graph/index.xml and .grace/verification/index.xml, keeping module maps, graph ownership and verification evidence synchronized with the implementation.

T-004.Title: Prove the full readiness gate and record evidence without any release action

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Re-run the file-level suite and the live checked-in Collecting-train gate after all edits, confirm tags, refs and history are untouched, docs/release-trains/2.9.x-next.json is byte-unchanged and every other readiness gate (lifecycle, membership, testing protocol, owner acceptance, seal span, screenshot freshness, required checks, payload/seal/tag/checkout identity, lane trains) is unchanged, record execution evidence in .grace/changes/active/C-RELEASE-REWRITE-BOUNDARY/evidence/execution-report.md, and hand off exact deltas with no release authorization, admission decision, version decision or publication action.
